guide.singulo.catalysts.slots.body.source:
Machines that use catalysts have a dedicated slot that accepts only catalysts (the slot marked with a catalyst icon). Nothing else fits.
A used-up catalyst becomes a spent catalyst. In the Catalytic Reactor, about 25% of it can be recovered as material for the catalyst one tier lower.
guide.singulo.catalysts.slots.body.translation:
使用催化劑的裝置有只能放入催化劑的專用槽（介面中帶有催化劑標記的格子），其他物品放不進去。
用盡的催化劑會變成失活催化劑。在催化反應器中，約 25% 可回收為低一級催化劑的材料。

guide.singulo.catalysts.tiers.body.source:
Muon (2), BE condensate (3), time crystal (4), Singularity Core (5).
- Same tier as the machine: standard
- One tier higher: speed +25%, wear −20% (stacks up to two tiers higher)
- One tier lower: ×0.5 speed, ×2 wear (generators run at 25% of their rated output)
- Two tiers lower: unusable
As a catalyst wears down, the power it needs rises (up to ×1.6); below 80% power, incomplete reactions make it wear ×1.5 faster.
These rules apply to devices that run on a catalyst slot (anchors, stabilizers, generators, shields and so on). When a processing recipe lists a catalyst as an ingredient, it uses a fixed count or amount of life and the speed does not change (for example, a BE condensate catalyst takes one muon catalyst and 40 seconds).
guide.singulo.catalysts.tiers.body.translation:
緲子（2）、玻色凝聚態（3）、時間晶體（4）、奇點核心（5）。
- 與裝置同級：標準
- 高一級：速度 +25%，消耗 −20%（最多疊加到高兩級）
- 低一級：速度 ×0.5，消耗 ×2（發電機輸出為額定的 25%）
- 低兩級：無法使用
剩餘越少，所需電力越多（最多 ×1.6）；電力低於 80% 時會因反應不完全而使消耗 ×1.5。
這些規則適用於靠催化劑槽運轉的裝置（錨、穩定器、發電機、護盾等）。加工配方中作為材料列出的催化劑，只消耗固定數量或壽命，速度不變（例如：玻色凝聚態催化劑的加工需要 1 個緲子催化劑，耗時 40 秒）。

guide.singulo.catalysts.time.body.source: In a P-Reactor's pull zone time slows down: catalysts wear at ×0.5 (machines run at ×0.8). Inside a T-Cylinder field it is the reverse, ×2. The two cancel out where they overlap. Keeping catalyst storage near the reactor makes them last longer.
guide.singulo.catalysts.time.body.translation: 彭羅斯反應爐的引力區內時間變慢：催化劑消耗為 ×0.5（裝置為 ×0.8）。蒂普勒圓柱的範圍內則相反，為 ×2。兩者重疊時會互相抵消。把催化劑倉庫放在爐旁能用得更久。

guide.singulo.genesis.birth.body.source:
1. Kindling: pour in 1.5 TFE (at most 1 GFE per tick) — a little over a minute at full P-Reactor output.
2. Stabilizing: hold 100 MFE/t for about four minutes of active progress (it pauses while the feed is stopped or power runs short, so expect a little longer). Now and then a surge alarm sounds: stop the feed while it lasts (the switch on the screen that opens when you use the core empty-handed, or a redstone signal). Keep feeding and instability spikes; at 100% the proto-universe collapses and progress is lost. Upkeep still drains the buffer and events still happen while stopped. Watch out for gravity leaks, echoes and gravity waves. A shield softens surges and events; a T-Cylinder field speeds things up.
3. Birth: the light falls into a point and a universe is born. Its galaxy rises into the overworld night sky.
Use the core empty-handed to open its screen: stage, progress, instability and input.
guide.singulo.genesis.birth.body.translation:
1. 種火：注入 1.5 TFE（每 tick 最多 1 GFE）。彭羅斯反應爐全力運轉約需一分多鐘。
2. 穩定化：維持 100 MFE/t，實際推進約 4 分鐘（停止投料或電力不足時不會推進，所以實際會稍久一些）。期間會不時響起「失控徵兆」警報，警報持續時請停止投料（空手對核心使用開啟介面並按下開關，或對核心給予紅石訊號）。若持續投料，不穩定度會急遽上升，到達 100% 時即將誕生的宇宙會崩塌，進度倒退。停止投料期間，儲能仍會被維持電力消耗，事件也照樣發生。也要留意重力外洩、記錄的殘響與引力之波。在護盾範圍內，失控與事件會減弱；在蒂普勒圓柱的加速場內，進度會加快。
3. 誕生：光墜向一點，宇宙隨之誕生。誕生的銀河會升上主世界的夜空。
空手對核心使用會開啟介面，可查看階段、進度、不穩定度與受電。

guide.singulo.genesis.build.body.source:
The old civilization fell trying to turn all mass into energy. The Genesis Engine does the reverse.
- Eight Genesis Frames level with the core: three blocks out on each axis, and two-and-two on each diagonal.
- Three Genesis Pylons stacked on each of the four diagonal frames (twelve in all).
The core chimes when formed. Use a Primordial Seed on it to begin. Power enters from any side.
guide.singulo.genesis.build.body.translation:
舊文明試圖將「所有質量化為能量」而走向滅亡。創世爐正好相反，是以能量孕育宇宙的爐。
- 在核心周圍同一高度放置 8 個創世爐框架：十字方向距核心 3 格處 4 個，斜向 2 格 × 2 格處 4 個。
- 在 4 個斜向框架上各疊 3 層創世爐支柱（共 12 根）。
成形時核心會發出聲響。對核心使用原初之種即可開始（需要漩渦斷章）。電力可從任何一面輸入。

guide.singulo.genesis.synth.body.source:
A Genesis Engine that has given birth can make items from power. Use the core empty-handed to open its screen and put the item you want in the left frame (or use the item on the core). Collect results from the slot on the right (or pull them from below with a hopper).
Cost per item = mass × 1 GFE × 10^rarity. Rarity runs from 0 (stone, dirt) to 4 (nether star, elytra, dragon egg), so rarer items cost orders of magnitude more power. A broken core keeps the memory of its universe and works again wherever you place it, but stored power and partial progress are lost, so do not break it in the middle of an expensive item. The list of items is a datapack (mass_synthesis).
guide.singulo.genesis.synth.body.translation:
誕生了宇宙的創世爐能將電力轉化為物品。空手使用核心開啟介面，把想製造的物品登記到左側框中（手持物品對核心使用也可登記）。完成的物品可從介面右側的欄位取出（也可用漏斗等從下方抽出）。
每個物品的電力 = 質量 × 1 GFE × 10^稀有度。稀有度從 0（石頭、泥土等）到 4（地獄之星、鞘翅、龍蛋等），越稀有的物品耗電量高出好幾個數量級。拆下的核心會保留宇宙的記憶，放到別處後仍可直接使用（但儲存的電力與未完成的進度不會保留，製造昂貴物品途中請勿拆除）。可製造的物品由資料包（mass_synthesis）定義。

guide.singulo.hazards.list.body.source:
- The reactor's tidal zone (radius 4) deals damage that ignores armour.
- A broken hydrogen container causes a small explosion near fire.
- A large particle accelerator may occasionally leak a strangelet, which turns one nearby block per second into strange matter (it stops at radius 8 or 512 blocks and does not spread inside a shield). Contain and collect it with a Magnetic Bottle.
guide.singulo.hazards.list.body.translation:
- 反應爐的潮汐區（半徑 4）造成的傷害會無視護甲。
- 氫氣容器損壞時，若靠近火源會發生小型爆炸。
- 大規模運轉的粒子加速器偶爾會洩漏奇異子，每秒把附近 1 個方塊轉化為奇異夸克物質方塊（到半徑 8 或 512 個方塊為止，不會擴散進護盾內）。可用磁瓶將其封存並回收。

guide.singulo.intro.basics.body.source:
Power (FE) travels through Singulo cables; items and fluids use per-side settings and other mods' pipes.
From stage 2 you use catalysts: consumables with a lifetime, placed in a dedicated catalyst slot. One tier above the machine is faster; one below is slower and wears faster; two below cannot be used.
Ancient ruins hold records and parts you cannot craft. Start looking for Observation Posts early.
guide.singulo.intro.basics.body.translation:
電力（FE）透過 Singulo 的電纜傳輸；物品與流體則透過裝置各面的設定與其他模組的管線傳輸。
從第 2 階段開始會用到催化劑：有壽命的消耗品，放在專用的催化劑槽中。等級比裝置高一級時速度較快；低一級時速度較慢且消耗較快；低兩級則無法使用。
古代廢墟中保存著無法製作的記錄與零件。及早開始尋找地表觀測站吧。

guide.singulo.intro.howto.body.source:
- Pick a chapter on the left to show its pages on the right. Turn pages with the arrows at the bottom.
- The Progress chapter shows the goals you have reached and the next ones (the same as the Singulo tab of the advancements screen, L key).
- Hover over an item for its description; hold Shift to see how it is made and what it is used for.
- Use the Holo Projector on a multiblock controller to show the correct shape as a translucent outline.
guide.singulo.intro.howto.body.translation:
- 選擇左側的章節，右側會顯示頁面。用下方的箭頭翻頁。
- 「進度」章節會顯示已達成與下一個目標（與進度畫面〔L 鍵〕的 Singulo 分頁相同）。
- 將滑鼠移到物品上可查看說明；按住 Shift 可查看製作方式與用途。
- 對多方塊結構的控制器使用全像投影器，正確的形狀會以半透明方式浮現。

guide.singulo.intro.welcome.body.source:
Singulo is a tech mod about extracting energy from mass. Start with thermoelectric power, build up cryogenic, quantum and temporal technology stage by stage, and finally generate power from a spinning black hole (the P-Reactor).
There are five stages. Each has a goal machine and a key material that opens the next stage. Read from "Stage 1" on the left to know what to build next.
guide.singulo.intro.welcome.body.translation:
Singulo 是一個「從質量中提取能量」的科技模組。從熱電發電起步，逐步累積低溫、量子與時間技術，最後以旋轉的黑洞（彭羅斯反應爐）發電。
共有五個階段。每個階段都有目標裝置，以及通往下一階段的關鍵材料。從左側的「第 1 階段」開始依序閱讀，就能知道接下來該建造什麼。

guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.body.source:
- Cryogenic Cooling Tower (5×5, 7–15 high): cooling_tower
- Particle Accelerator (ring 8–32 wide): particle_accelerator
- Degenerate Compactor (5×5×5): degenerate_compactor
- C-Cavity (5×5×5): casimir_cavity
- Degenerate Furnace (5×5×7): degenerate_furnace
- P-Reactor (13×13×13): penrose_reactor
- Event Horizon Shield Tower (5×5, 9 high): event_horizon_shield
- T-Cylinder (5×5×9): tipler_cylinder
- Wormhole Generator (5×5×5 sphere): wormhole_generator
guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.body.translation:
- 低溫冷卻塔（5×5，高 7–15）：cooling_tower
- 粒子加速器（環邊長 8–32）：particle_accelerator
- 簡併壓縮爐（5×5×5）：degenerate_compactor
- 卡西米爾腔（5×5×5）：casimir_cavity
- 簡併熱爐（5×5×7）：degenerate_furnace
- 彭羅斯反應爐（13×13×13）：penrose_reactor
- 事件視界護盾塔（5×5，高 9）：event_horizon_shield
- 蒂普勒圓柱（5×5×9）：tipler_cylinder
- 蟲洞產生器（5×5×5 球體）：wormhole_generator

guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body.source:
1. Place the controller (its front faces you and the structure extends behind it).
2. Right-click the controller with the Holo Projector. The correct shape is projected, and the required and missing counts appear in chat.
3. Place the shown blocks in the cyan boxes and remove the blocks in the red ones. When everything is in place the projection disappears, light runs along the seams and the machine starts.
4. For machines with a choice of size (the cooling tower and the accelerator), sneak-use the projector to switch sizes.
In creative mode, /singulo build <name> [size] builds it in one go.
guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body.translation:
1. 放置控制器（正面朝向自己，結構往其後方延伸）。
2. 用全像投影器右鍵控制器，正確的形狀會投影出來，所需數量與缺少的數量會顯示在聊天欄。
3. 在青色框中放入所示方塊，移除紅色框中的方塊。全部就位後投影消失，接縫處閃過光芒，裝置啟動。
4. 可選尺寸的裝置（冷卻塔、加速器）潛行使用投影器即可切換尺寸。
創造模式下可用 /singulo build <名稱> [尺寸] 一次建成。

guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.titl.translation: 全像投影器的使用方式

guide.singulo.power.cables.body.source: Copper wire (2 kFE/t, with losses) → superconducting cable (1 MFE/t) → topological wire (100 MFE/t) → horizon bus (no limit; up to about 2.1 GFE/t per machine from other mods). A connected network carries only what its thinnest cable can.
guide.singulo.power.cables.body.translation: 銅導線（2 kFE/t，有損耗）→ 超導電纜（1 MFE/t）→ 拓撲導線（100 MFE/t）→ 視界匯流排（無上限；送往其他模組的裝置每台最多約 2.1 GFE/t）。相連網路的傳輸量取決於其中最細的電纜。

guide.singulo.power.sides.body.source: Use the Sides button in an ordinary processing machine screen to set each face to off / input / output / both, with optional auto-eject. Multiblocks use designated I/O ports; the P-Reactor uses Extraction Ports. Machines that output two gases, such as the electrolyzer, have a tab for each gas. The power button stops a machine, and machines that can make something from power alone have a switch to skip those recipes.
guide.singulo.power.sides.body.translation: 使用一般加工機器畫面中的「面設定」按鈕，可將每個面設為停用／輸入／輸出／輸入輸出，並可開啟自動排出。多方塊結構使用指定的輸入輸出埠；彭羅斯反應爐使用提取埠。輸出兩種氣體的裝置（如電解槽）可為每種氣體分別設定輸出面。電源按鈕可讓裝置停止；能只靠電力製造產物的裝置有開關，可跳過這些配方。

guide.singulo.power.wormhole.body.source: The only wireless link. Generate a pair of mouths, stabilize them within 60 s using exotic matter and a mouth casing, then carry one away and place it. A port within 8 blocks of a mouth links to the port with the same number (0-127, set with the seven circles in its screen) near the twin mouth, joining power, items and fluids. Each mouth runs 8, 32 or 128 ports depending on its throat size, nearest first, and active ports glow. Throughput also grows with the throat and is unlimited at 7x7. Mouths run on exotic matter and close when it runs out; a newly placed mouth stays open for 5 minutes without fuel.
guide.singulo.power.wormhole.body.translation: 唯一的無線連結。產生一對入口，在 60 秒內用奇異物質和入口外殼將其穩定，然後帶走其中一個並放置。入口 8 格內的埠會與另一端入口附近編號相同（0-127，在介面中用 7 個圓圈設定）的埠相連，直接連通電力、物品和液體。每個入口依喉部大小可讓 8、32 或 128 個埠運作，依距離由近到遠，運作中的埠會發光。可傳輸的量也隨喉部變大，7×7 時不受上限限制。入口以奇異物質維持，耗盡時會關閉；新放置的入口無需燃料也會保持開啟 5 分鐘。

guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.body.source: A Halo Collector placed within 16 blocks of a core collects it. It leaks from ordinary containers, so keep it in a Gravitational Containment Tank. Fed directly into the core, it becomes mass without the Eddington limit.
guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.body.translation: 把暈收集器放在爐心 16 格以內即可收集。它會從一般容器中洩漏，因此要存放在重力約束槽中。直接投入爐心時，不受愛丁頓極限限制即可成為質量。

guide.singulo.romance.gear.body.source:
- Metric Drive: keep it in your inventory and switch between low gravity, zero gravity (flight) and high gravity.
- Graviton Manipulator: levitate, pull, repel and crush. The G key switches to a cone area.
- Advanced Worldline Anchor: with a core embedded, it keeps a radius of 5 loaded with no upkeep.
guide.singulo.romance.gear.body.translation:
- 度規驅動器：放在物品欄中，在低重力、無重力（飛行）與高重力之間切換。
- 重力子操控器：懸浮、牽引、斥力、壓潰。按 G 鍵切換為錐形範圍。
- 世界線錨（進階）：嵌入核心後無需消耗即可維持半徑 5 的區塊載入。

guide.singulo.romance.shield.body.source: A tower (5×5, 9 high) that protects a radius of 32. A time crystal catalyst stops explosions and griefing; a Singularity Core also stops hostile spawns and intruders. Uses 16,384 FE/t.
guide.singulo.romance.shield.body.translation: 保護半徑 32 範圍的塔（5×5，高 9）。使用時間晶體催化劑可防止爆炸與破壞；使用奇點核心還能阻止敵對生物生成與入侵。耗電 16,384 FE/t。

guide.singulo.romance.tipler.body.source: Speeds up time within a radius of 16 (×2; 5×5×9). Fuel and catalyst go in through the core's screen: a time crystal catalyst, exotic matter (one per minute) and 100 kFE/t.
guide.singulo.romance.tipler.body.translation: 使半徑 16 內的時間加速（×2；5×5×9）。燃料與催化劑從核心的介面放入：時間晶體催化劑、奇異物質（每分鐘 1 個）以及 100 kFE/t。

guide.singulo.ruins.bosses.body.source:
The caches of the Research Building, Culture Facility and Final Lab stay sealed until you defeat their guardian. When the loot regrows the cache reseals and the guardian returns. If every challenger leaves, a guardian waits three minutes (time to come back after falling) and then resets. The server setting bossHardMode makes guardians stronger. Their drops appear on the guardian core in the floor (on the seal console for the Warden), and their experience goes straight to each challenger in the room.
Guardians grow stronger with the number of challengers: each extra player adds half of their health and shortens their attack gaps a little (up to six players). Joining mid-fight keeps the health fraction, and leaving never weakens them. In return they drop their loot once per challenger present when the fight begins (late joiners do not add more). Everyone's attacks land without blocking each other, though each player still needs the usual short pause between hits.
- Echo Sentinel (Research Building archive): a security hologram that orbits you firing homing bolts and blinks behind you to strike when you stop watching it. The Echo Projectors in the corners shield it and fire light lances in volleys (move when the golden aim lines appear); step out of a projected circle before its pillar rises. Break the projectors first. Below half health it summons one-hit echoes; projector beams only reach the real one. Drops Sentinel Projection Cores.
- Gravity Remnant (Culture Facility containment chamber): a black core that bursts from its tank. While its rubble shell lasts it takes reduced damage and loses a piece per hit; it fires the rubble at you. It lifts nearby foes and slams them down, so Gravity Boots or Impact Generators help. Below half health a gravity well drags you toward the core. The well pulls, charges with a glow and a sound, bursts nearby foes outward, then drifts the Remnant to another spot. Drops Degenerate Nuclei.
- Horizon Warden (Final Lab): touch the central Seal Console to wake it. In its last phase it opens singularities at your feet; they warn for a second before they pull, so step away. After beating it, use an Awakening Record Core on the console for a rematch with the awakened warden (2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster and earlier phases). Leave and the core is returned.
- Ergosphere Leviathan (Sunken Reactor Sector): approach the dead core in the floor of the spherical chamber and it appears. It changes form at 2/3 and 1/3 health (invulnerable while it changes). Its wake drags you along the way it swam: ride the flow to keep up. The glowing gold core in its tail is always a weak point.
  Armored: reactor-plate scales, armored body. A cyan glow on the head means a dive (leave the marked spot); when the maw opens, do not stand in front (it pulls you in, then breathes a beam). Stay near its tail and it lashes you. After a dive grazes the floor it lingers low for a moment: your chance to strike back.
  Skeleton: it blasts its scales away (painful up close) and becomes a skeleton of light; its body now takes full damage. It coils in the middle of the room, dragging you around while firing light shards, bites when you come close and chains its dives.
  Wyrm: it dives into the core vortex and erupts as a black wyrm. Two relativistic jets sweep from its horns, it circles high and rains small black holes where you stand (a light pillar warns you); where it rests after a dive, it leaves a singularity as it takes off. Drops Chapters of the Vortex.
  In any form: when it rises and curls up, it slams the center and two shockwaves race across the floor (jump them). When lines of light cross the floor, get off them before the rift tears open (three volleys, each at a new angle). The skeleton and wyrm also open the core vortex to drag everything in (the core hurts; run against the pull).
  Core Reignition: as skeleton and wyrm it coils around the core, charges, and blasts the whole room. When the warning appears, hide behind a containment pillar (the Reinforced Ruin Glass in the pillars blocks it too).
- Awakened guardians: after beating the Echo Sentinel or Gravity Remnant, use an Awakened Echo Core or Awakened Gravity Core on the guardian core in the room's floor (2.5× health, 1.5× damage, faster moves, enraged at 65%). The sentinel adds an echo and a bolt and re-projects up to two broken projectors when enraged; the remnant fires more debris, widens its gravity well and chains its slams. Leave and the core is returned.
guide.singulo.ruins.bosses.body.translation:
研究棟、封閉培養設施和最終實驗室的保管庫，在擊敗各自的守衛之前都被力場封鎖。內容物再生後會重新封鎖，守衛也會回來；所有挑戰者離開房間後，守衛仍會停留 3 分鐘（讓倒下的人回來取裝備），之後若無人返回才會復原。開啟伺服器設定 bossHardMode 後，守衛會變得更強。擊敗後的掉落物會出現在地板上的守衛封印核心（視界守衛為封印控制台）上方，經驗則直接給予房間內的每位挑戰者。
人數越多，守衛就越強：每多一名玩家，體力增加原本的一半，招式間隔也會稍微縮短（最多計算 6 人）。中途加入時體力比例保持不變，有人離開也不會變弱。相對地，掉落物會按戰鬥開始時的挑戰者人數掉落（之後加入的人不會增加掉落）。多人攻擊時，每個人的攻擊都不會被他人擋住（同一個人連續攻擊，仍需像以往一樣稍作間隔）。
- 回聲守衛（研究棟的檔案室）：一進入房間就會出現的警衛全像投影。它在空中繞著你飛行並發射追蹤光彈，一旦你不再看著它，就會瞬移到你背後斬擊（瞬移前會聚集光芒）。回聲投影器不僅保護守衛，還會一齊射出光之槍（出現金色瞄準線時要移動）；腳下映出光陣時，要在光柱升起前走出陣外。投影器剩得越多，攻擊越難奏效，所以先把它們打掉。體力低於一半時會召喚一擊即消的分身；投影器的光只會連向本體。掉落守衛投影核心。
- 重力殘渣（封閉培養設施的隔離槽室）：衝破收容槽而出的黑色核心。瓦礫外殼還在時受到的傷害較小，每受一擊剝落一塊；它會把瓦礫射向你。它會把周圍的對手抬起再砸向地面，因此重力靴或衝擊發電面板會很有幫助。體力低於一半時會形成重力井，把你拉向核心（碰到核心會受傷）。重力井在拉扯之後會蓄力（有光和聲音預兆），把附近的對手彈飛，然後漂移到房間的其他位置。掉落簡併核。
- 視界守衛（最終實驗室）：觸碰中央的封印控制台即可喚醒。最後形態在你腳下展開的奇點會先預警 1 秒再開始牽引，請立刻離開。擊敗後，在控制台上使用覺醒記錄核，即可與覺醒的守衛再戰（生命 2.5 倍、傷害 1.5 倍、更快且更早進入後續階段）。離開房間時記錄核會返還。
- 能層巨蛇（沉沒的爐心區）：靠近球形收容室地板上停止的爐心，牠就會現身。體力降到 2/3 和 1/3 時會改變形態（變化期間不會受傷）。牠游過的軌跡會把你朝牠游動的方向沖走：順著水流追上去吧。尾部發金光的核心始終是弱點。
  裝甲：披著反應爐外殼的鱗片，軀幹堅硬。頭部發出青光是衝撞的信號（離開被鎖定的地方）；巨口張開時不要站在正前方（先吸過去，再吐出光束）。靠近尾巴會被橫掃。衝撞掠過地面後，牠會在地面附近停留片刻，正是反擊的好機會。
  骨骼：把鱗片全部彈飛（靠近會受傷），化為光之骨骼，軀幹也能造成全額傷害。牠會在房間中央盤成一圈旋轉，把你捲著沖走並發射光之碎片；靠近會被咬，衝撞會連續而來。
  龍：潛入爐心的漩渦，化為黑龍噴湧而出。雙角射出旋轉的兩道光束（相對論性噴流），在高空盤旋時向你腳下降下小型黑洞（光柱是預兆），衝撞後停下的地方，會在牠飛離時留下奇點。掉落漩渦斷章。
  任何形態：牠高高升起並蜷起身體時，會砸向中心，兩道衝擊波沿地面擴散（波到來時跳起）。地面出現光線時，要在空間裂開前離開線上（共三次，每次改變方向）。骨骼與龍形態還會打開爐心之渦，把整個房間往裡拉（靠近爐心會受傷，要逆著引力向外跑）。
  爐心再點火：骨骼與龍形態會纏繞爐心蓄力，向整個房間釋放衝擊。出現預兆時，躲到封鎖柱後面（柱上的強化廢墟玻璃也能擋住衝擊）。
- 覺醒的守衛：擊敗回聲守衛或重力殘渣後，在房間地板上的守衛封印核心上使用覺醒回聲核或覺醒重力核，即可再戰（生命 2.5 倍、傷害 1.5 倍、招式更快、體力 65% 時狂暴）。回聲守衛會多一個分身和一發光彈，狂暴時最多重新投影兩個被破壞的投影器；重力殘渣會射出更多瓦礫，重力井更大，並會連續砸地。離開房間時覺醒核會返還。

guide.singulo.ruins.compass.body.source: At first the compass only finds Observation Posts. Sneak-use it on the cache of a ruin you have cleared to tune it for the next one: Research Building, then Culture Facility, then Final Lab, then Sunken Reactor Sector. Underground ruins lie below the spot it points to.
guide.singulo.ruins.compass.body.translation: 羅盤起初只能搜尋地表觀測站。潛行右鍵你已攻略的廢墟的廢墟保管庫，即可調校以搜尋下一處：研究棟，然後是封閉培養設施，再是最終實驗室，最後是沉沒的爐心區。地下廢墟位於指針所指位置的下方。

guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.body.source:
- Meteor craters (plains, deserts, forests and other surface biomes): a shallow bowl about 10 blocks across with a half-buried meteorite. Mine meteoric iron chunks (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron and stardust clusters on the black crust for stardust. Clusters slowly regrow, but only on crust still in its crater. Each meteorite has one meteorite core at its heart; mine it for raw meteoric iron and stardust together. The Meteor Compass points to the nearest core not yet mined.
- Fulgurite: lightning striking sand turns it into fulgurite. Stand a lightning rod on sand and it forms under the rod in thunderstorms. The stage 3 Keraunos Discharge Tower fires artificial lightning at a rod on demand.
- Pressure crystals (stage 3): a Deep-Sea Pressure Collector on the sea floor with 16+ blocks of water above slowly makes them; deeper is faster.
- Void dust (stages 4-5): a Void Collector in the End, placed over open void, gathers it.
guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.body.translation:
- 隕石坑（平原、沙漠、森林等地表生態域）：直徑約 10 格的淺碗狀坑，中心有半埋的隕石。用鐵鎬或更好的鎬開採隕鐵塊得到粗隕鐵，從黑色熔殼上長出的星塵晶簇得到星塵。星塵晶簇會慢慢重新長出，但只限於原本就在隕石坑裡的熔殼。每塊隕石的中心埋著一個隕石核心，開採後可同時得到粗隕鐵和星塵。隕石羅盤會指向最近的尚未開採的核心。
- 閃電熔岩：閃電擊中沙子會把沙子變成閃電熔岩塊。把避雷針立在沙子上，每逢雷雨就會在避雷針下方形成。有了第 3 階段的克勞諾斯放電塔，可以隨時用電力向避雷針發射人工閃電。
- 高壓晶體（第 3 階段）：把深海壓力收集器放在上方有 16 格以上海水的海底，會被水壓慢慢壓成（越深越快）。
- 虛空之塵（第 4~5 階段）：把虛空收集器放在終界正下方直到虛空都空無一物的地方即可收集。

guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.title.translation: 只能在特定地點獲得的素材

guide.singulo.ruins.list.body.source:
- Observation Post: the only ruin above ground, on plains, deserts and similar surfaces. White security drones. Observation logs and control units (regrow in 7 days).
- Research Building: shallow underground (around Y −20 to 4). Security machines and the Echo Sentinel in the archive room at the back. Cold atom traps and quantum data fragments (7 days).
- Culture Facility: deep underground (around Y −46 to −30). A cryogenic core, stronger security machines and the Gravity Remnant in the containment room at the back. Time crystal seeds and culture data (14 days).
- Final Lab: a gravity anomaly deepest underground (around Y −56 to −46). The Horizon Warden guards it. Singularity seeds and anomaly samples (14 days).
- Sunken Reactor Sector: a dead second reactor even deeper than the Final Lab (around Y −60 to −54). Tune the explorer compass after clearing the Final Lab to find it. The Ergosphere Leviathan. Exotic matter, jet condensate and H-Condensate (14 days).
guide.singulo.ruins.list.body.translation:
- 地表觀測站：平原、沙漠等地表上唯一建在地面的遺蹟。白色警衛無人機。觀測日誌、控制單元（7 天再生）。
- 研究棟：淺層地下（約 Y −20〜4）。警衛機，以及深處檔案室的回聲守衛。冷原子陷阱、量子資料片段（7 天）。
- 封閉培養設施：深層地下（約 Y −46〜−30）。低溫核心、更強的警衛機，以及深處隔離槽室的重力殘渣。時間晶種、培養資料（14 天）。
- 最終實驗室：最深處地下（約 Y −56〜−46）的重力異常點。由視界守衛看守。奇點種子、異常樣本（14 天）。
- 沉沒的爐心區：比最終實驗室更深的地下（約 Y −60〜−54），停止運轉的第二座反應爐。攻略最終實驗室後調整探索羅盤即可尋找。能層巨蛇。奇異物質、噴流凝聚體、霍金凝聚體（14 天）。

guide.singulo.ruins.plan.body.source:
Destinations pile up in later stages; gathering early keeps the factory running.
- During stage 2: meteor craters (meteoric iron, stardust), icebergs or ice spikes (packed and blue ice).
- During stage 3: Research Buildings. Place deep-sea pressure collectors early to stock pressure crystals (about 30 for shells and the anvil). Put lightning rods on sand in thunderstorms.
- Before stage 4: Culture Facility, an ancient city (sculk and echo shards; the echo resonator keeps copying one shard), the End void (void collector), and the Wither (nether stars; artificial star cores replace them after ignition).
- Original records can be repaired: new plus three repairs gives about 2.7× the uses. Repair before re-running a ruin.
guide.singulo.ruins.plan.body.translation:
後期階段的目的地會一下子增多；提前收集可以讓工廠不停工。
- 第 2 階段期間：隕石坑（隕鐵、星塵），冰山或冰刺（浮冰和藍冰）。
- 第 3 階段期間：研究棟。儘早放置深海壓力收集器，囤積高壓晶體（外殼和砧約需 30 個）。雷雨天在沙子上放避雷針。
- 第 4 階段之前：封閉培養設施、遠古城市（幽匿塊和回聲碎片；回聲共鳴器可以一直複製一片）、終界虛空（虛空收集器）、凋零怪（地獄之星；點火後可用人造星核代替）。
- 原始記錄可以修復：新品加三次修復約為 2.7 倍的使用次數。重刷遺跡之前先修復。

guide.singulo.ruins.records.body.source: Ruin caches sometimes hold crystal memories. Decode them with power in the Archive Terminal to read the records of the old civilization (they are added to the Ancient Records chapter of this handbook). Collect them all to learn why the civilization fell.
guide.singulo.ruins.records.body.translation: 廢墟保管庫中有時會出現水晶記憶體。在檔案終端消耗電力解讀後，即可閱讀舊文明的記錄（會加入手冊的「舊文明的記錄」章節）。全部集齊，就能知道文明滅亡的原因。

guide.singulo.ruins.sealed.body.source: Each ruin hides a sealed container that opens only with the key of the next stage: magnetic, quantum, temporal, then singularity. Keys are made in the Precision Assembler and used up each time. Inside are materials, coloured lamps and sometimes a rare item found nowhere else: Overclock Chip, Gravity Boots, Catalyst Stabilizer or Dimensional Pocket. Breaking a sealed container destroys its contents. You can craft containers too, and sneak-use a key to seal one.
guide.singulo.ruins.sealed.body.translation: 每座廢墟都藏著一個封印容器，只能用下一階段的鑰匙打開：磁力鎖、量子鎖、時間鎖，最後是奇點鎖。鑰匙在精密組裝台製造，每次使用都會消耗。裡面有材料、彩色燈，有時還有別處找不到的稀有道具：超頻晶片、重力靴、催化劑穩定劑或次元口袋。強行破壞封印中的容器會連同內容物一起失去。你也可以自己製作容器，潛行時使用鑰匙即可封印。

guide.singulo.stage1.goal.body.source:
The key to stage 2 is the Superconducting Coil. It is made in the Cryogenic Cooling Tower and needs a Control Unit found at an Observation Post.
- Find an Observation Post (on plains, deserts and other surfaces) and bring back the degraded control unit and observation log from its cache.
- Restore the control unit in the Archive Terminal.
- Gather the cooling tower parts and build it with the Holo Projector.
guide.singulo.stage1.goal.body.translation:
通往第 2 階段的關鍵是超導線圈。它在低溫冷卻塔中製作，需要在地表觀測站拾得的控制單元作為材料。
- 尋找地表觀測站（平原、沙漠等地表），從保管庫帶回退化的控制單元與觀測日誌。
- 在檔案終端修復控制單元。
- 備齊冷卻塔的零件，用全像投影器建造。

guide.singulo.stage1.machines.body.source:
- Kiln: fires ceramic substrates and more. It also makes steel faster.
- Compressor: makes steel plates. In mass mode it turns materials with a mass value into "mass" and presses it into compressed blocks and mass pellets.
- Electrolyzer: splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
- Archive Terminal: copies ruin records onto data cards and restores degraded parts. It also decodes crystal memories.
guide.singulo.stage1.machines.body.translation:
- 燒製爐：燒製陶瓷基板等，也能更快地煉鋼。
- 壓縮機：製作鋼板。質量模式下會把有質量值的材料變成「質量」，壓成壓縮塊或質量顆粒。
- 電解槽：將水分解為氫氣與氧氣。
- 檔案終端：把遺蹟的記錄抄寫到資料卡上，修復退化的零件，也能解讀水晶記憶體。

guide.singulo.stage1.materials.body.source:
1. Mix iron and coal into steel blend and smelt it into steel ingots in a blast furnace.
2. Make unfired ceramic from clay, nether quartz, bone meal and sand, and fire it in a furnace into white ceramic composite. Before you reach the Nether, two flint can replace the nether quartz.
3. Make basic circuits from ceramic, redstone and copper, and basic frames from steel and ceramic.
These three (steel, ceramic and circuits) go into almost every machine.
guide.singulo.stage1.materials.body.translation:
1. 用鐵和煤炭製作鋼混合物，在高爐中煉成鋼錠。
2. 用黏土、地獄石英、骨粉和沙子製作未燒製陶瓷，在熔爐中燒成白色陶瓷複合材料。前往地獄之前，可用 2 個燧石代替地獄石英。
3. 用陶瓷、紅石和銅製作基本電路，用鋼和陶瓷製作基本框架。
這三樣（鋼、陶瓷、電路）是幾乎所有裝置的材料。

guide.singulo.stage1.power.body.source:
The Thermoelectric Generator produces power from a temperature difference (0.10 FE/t per kelvin): put something hot (a magma block, a lit campfire or kiln) on one side and something cold (blue ice, packed ice) on the other.
Each cold block only tolerates so much difference; beyond that it melts into another block (water evaporates). See the next page for pairs that last.
Connect machines with copper wire.
guide.singulo.stage1.power.body.translation:
熱電發電機透過溫差發電（每 1 K 溫差 0.10 FE/t）：在一側放熱的東西（岩漿塊、點燃的營火或燒製爐），另一側放冷的東西（藍冰、浮冰）。
每種冷方塊能承受的溫差有限，超過後會融化成別的方塊（水會蒸發）。不會融化的組合見下一頁。
用銅導線連接機器。

guide.singulo.stage1.thermal_pairs.body.source:
Pairs whose cold block never melts (output of one generator):
- Magma block + blue ice: about 76 FE/t (best)
- Running kiln + blue ice: about 66 FE/t
- Campfire + blue ice: about 56 FE/t
- Campfire + packed ice: about 55 FE/t
Lava is too hot: even blue ice turns into packed ice in about 40 s and keeps melting. Campfires with water, snow or ice melt them in under a minute.
To run the stage 2 Cryogenic Cooling Tower (240 FE/t for liquid nitrogen), plan on 4 or more generators with magma + blue ice, or 5 or more with campfire + packed ice (before copper wire losses). Start with 2–4 and run one machine at a time while you add more.
guide.singulo.stage1.thermal_pairs.body.translation:
冷方塊可以一直使用而不融化的組合（每台發電機的輸出）：
- 岩漿塊＋藍冰：約 76 FE/t（最推薦）
- 運轉中的燒製爐＋藍冰：約 66 FE/t
- 營火＋藍冰：約 56 FE/t
- 營火＋浮冰：約 55 FE/t
熔岩太熱：即使是藍冰也會在約 40 秒內變成浮冰並繼續融化。營火搭配水、雪或冰，不到 1 分鐘就會融化。
要運轉第 2 階段的低溫冷卻塔（液態氮 240 FE/t），岩漿塊＋藍冰大約需要 4 台以上，營火＋浮冰則需要 5 台以上（不含銅導線損耗）。先用 2–4 台，一次運轉一台機器，再逐步增加。

guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.body.source:
Build a square ring (8–32 wide) of accelerator tubes and focusing magnets and place the controller against the ring. The corners must be focusing magnets, and magnets must make up at least a quarter of the ring. It makes muon bundles from hydrogen, and very rarely a magnetic monopole.
The Catalytic Reactor turns muon bundles into muon catalysts (tier 2). A Cosmic Muon Collector placed high up slowly gathers muon bundles without power.
guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.body.translation:
用加速管與聚焦磁鐵組成方形環（邊長 8–32），並讓控制器緊貼著環放置。四個角落必須是聚焦磁鐵，且磁鐵至少佔環的四分之一。它以氫製造緲子束，極少數情況下會產生磁單極子。
催化反應器以緲子束製作緲子催化劑（2 級）。把宇宙射線緲子收集器放在高處，無需電力也能慢慢收集緲子束。

guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.title.translation: 粒子加速器與緲子催化劑

guide.singulo.stage2.goal.body.source: The keys to stage 3 are the Quantum Computing Module and liquid helium. Build the cooling tower 10 or more blocks high and liquefy helium released by crushing deepslate in the compressor. Also collect quantum data fragments from Research Buildings (surface to shallow underground).
guide.singulo.stage2.goal.body.translation: 通往第 3 階段的關鍵是量子運算模組與液態氦。把冷卻塔建到 10 格以上，並將壓縮機粉碎深板岩時產生的氦液化。也要在研究棟（地表到淺層地下）收集量子資料片段。

guide.singulo.stage2.others.body.source:
- Precision Assembler: makes almost every part and machine from stage 3 on.
- Cryogenic Turbine: generates power from evaporating liquid nitrogen (5 kFE/t).
- SMES Cell: stores a large amount of power.
- Small Worldline Anchor: keeps the surrounding chunks loaded while it has a catalyst.
- Monopole Upgrade: made from a magnetic monopole; in a machine's monopole slot it gives ×2 speed and +50% power efficiency.
guide.singulo.stage2.others.body.translation:
- 精密組裝台：第 3 階段以後幾乎所有零件與裝置都在這裡製作。
- 低溫渦輪機：利用液態氮氣化發電（5 kFE/t）。
- SMES 電池：儲存大量電力。
- 世界線錨（小型）：放入催化劑後持續載入周圍的區塊。
- 單極子升級模組：以磁單極子製作，插入裝置的單極子槽後速度 ×2、電力效率 +50%。

guide.singulo.stage2.tower.body.source:
Build a waisted hyperboloid tower 7–15 high on a 5×5 base. The middle column is heat exchange cores and the top is closed with a vent grate. The controller goes in the middle of the front face, second layer from the bottom. Taller towers are faster, and at 10 or more they also make liquid helium.
It makes liquid nitrogen from the air with no inputs. Superconducting coils are made from copper, redstone, steel plates, substrates, a control unit and liquid nitrogen.
Heat exchange cores and coolant bands can use 3 packed ice instead of blue ice. Making only nitrogen, a 7-high tower feeds about 3.5 cryogenic turbines and a 10-high tower 5 (fewer when it also processes coils; recipes with inputs run before nitrogen).
guide.singulo.stage2.tower.body.translation:
在 5×5 的基座上建造高 7–15 的收腰雙曲面塔。中央一列為熱交換核心，頂部用通風格柵封住。控制器放在正面從下往上第二層的中央。越高越快，10 格以上還能製造液態氦。
無需任何材料即可從空氣製造液態氮。超導線圈由銅、紅石、鋼板、基板、控制單元與液態氮製成。
熱交換核心和冷卻帶可用 3 個浮冰代替藍冰。只製造液態氮時，高 7 的塔約可供 3.5 台低溫渦輪機，高 10 的塔可供 5 台（同時加工線圈等時會減少；有材料的配方優先於液態氮）。

guide.singulo.stage3.goal.body.source: The key to stage 4 is exotic matter. It is made in the C-Cavity and needs time crystal catalysts. Search the Culture Facility (deepslate layer) for time crystal seeds and culture data. Watch out for the cryogenic section and the stronger security machines.
guide.singulo.stage3.goal.body.translation: 通往第 4 階段的關鍵是奇異物質。它在卡西米爾腔中製造，需要時間晶體催化劑。前往封閉培養設施（深板岩層）尋找時間晶種與培養資料吧。注意低溫區與更強的警衛機。

guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.body.source:
- Entanglement Synthesizer: entangled elements, two at a time.
- Laser Cooler: cold atoms, lattices, BE condensate catalyst.
- Quantum Heat Engine: catalyst-driven generator, 200 kFE/t on BE catalysts; a muon catalyst runs it at 25% (50 kFE/t) as a stopgap. It waits without wearing the catalyst while its storage is full.
guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.body.translation:
- 量子糾纏合成器：製作量子糾纏元件，一次兩個。
- 雷射冷卻器：製作冷原子、光學晶格基板、玻色凝聚態催化劑。
- 量子熱機：以催化劑驅動的發電機，使用玻色凝聚態催化劑時為 200 kFE/t；緲子催化劑可以 25%（50 kFE/t）臨時運轉。儲能已滿時會待機，不消耗催化劑。

guide.singulo.stage3.tools.body.source:
- Inertial Control Gauntlet: hold right-click to levitate or pull small mobs. It runs on power; sneak-right-click a block that holds power to charge it.
- Inertial Stabilizer: stops explosions from breaking blocks within a radius of 16.
- Gravitational Wave Detector: shows the rough direction and distance band of the Final Lab (gravity anomaly).
- Neutrino Scanner: shows the outlines of ruins and ores through terrain for 10 seconds. At first it shows up to iron and redstone; sensitivity modules (Mk2: gold, diamond, emerald; Mk3: ancient debris) reveal deeper ores. It also works on the observatory.
guide.singulo.stage3.tools.body.translation:
- 慣性控制手套：長按右鍵讓小型生物懸浮或將其拉近。消耗電力；潛行右鍵帶電的方塊即可充電。
- 慣性穩定器：半徑 16 內的爆炸不會破壞方塊。
- 重力波探測器：顯示最終實驗室（重力異常點）的大致方向與距離範圍。
- 微中子掃描器：在 10 秒內透過地形顯示遺蹟與礦石的輪廓。起初只能顯示到鐵與紅石；使用靈敏度模組（Mk2：金、鑽石、綠寶石；Mk3：遠古遺骸）後，更深層的礦石也會顯示。也可用於觀測站。

guide.singulo.stage4.compression.body.source:
In mass mode the compressor turns materials with a mass value into "mass" and presses it into compressed blocks, Lv1 → Lv2 → Lv3. Lv1 made from three or more kinds of source blocks is "mixed", and only 8 are needed for Lv2. There are also compressed metal blocks made of metals only.
The Degenerate Compactor (a closed 5×5×5 press) makes degenerate matter shells and reactor shell blocks.
guide.singulo.stage4.compression.body.translation:
壓縮機的質量模式會把有質量值的材料變成「質量」，依序壓成壓縮塊 Lv1 → Lv2 → Lv3。由 3 種以上原始方塊製成的 Lv1 為「混合」，只需 8 個即可製成 Lv2。另有只以金屬壓成的金屬壓縮塊。
簡併壓縮爐（封閉式 5×5×5 壓力機）用於製造簡併物質殼與反應爐外殼。

guide.singulo.stage4.goal.body.source: At the Final Lab (gravity anomaly), touch the seal console to wake the Horizon Warden. Defeat it and the cache opens, giving you a dormant singularity seed. Awaken it in the Singularity Encapsulator, then load it into the P-Reactor and ignite it.
guide.singulo.stage4.goal.body.translation: 在最終實驗室（重力異常點）觸碰封印控制台，視界守衛就會甦醒。擊敗它後保管庫開啟，即可取得休眠奇點種子。在奇點封裝器中將其喚醒，再放入彭羅斯反應爐點火。

guide.singulo.stage4.power.body.source:
- Degenerate Furnace (5×5×7): crushes compressed blocks Lv2 for 5 MFE/t. It uses a time crystal catalyst (a BE condensate catalyst runs it at 25%, 1.25 MFE/t, as a stopgap). Power leaves through its I/O ports automatically; while its storage is full it waits without using fuel or catalyst.
- Shells: one degenerate matter shell makes 24 reactor shell blocks. Ignition needs 6 shells for the plating plus 1 for the singularity seed. Gathering rock and metal in bulk helps.
- Probe Station: sends probes to discovered Observation Posts and brings back half the loot.
- Topological wire and SMES modules carry and store large amounts of power.
guide.singulo.stage4.power.body.translation:
- 簡併熱爐（5×5×7）：壓碎壓縮塊 Lv2 產生 5 MFE/t。使用時間晶體催化劑（玻色凝聚態催化劑也能以 25%、1.25 MFE/t 暫時運轉）。電力會自動從輸入輸出埠送出；儲能已滿時待機，不消耗燃料與催化劑。
- 簡併物質殼與反應爐外殼：1 個簡併物質殼可製作 24 塊反應爐外殼。點火前需要 6 個用於外殼，另加 1 個用於奇點種子。最好成批收集岩石與金屬。
- 自動探測站：向已發現的地表觀測站派出探測器，帶回一半數量的回收物。
- 拓撲導線與 SMES 模組用於傳輸與儲存大量電力。

guide.singulo.stage4.time.body.source:
The incubator grows time crystals over 12 minutes of real running time. At 80% of the requested power (24 kFE/t) or more purity is kept; time spent below that lowers purity and lifetime.
Equipment (core controller, singularity encapsulator, shield tower core and more) takes Time Crystal Modules: the precision assembler cuts two thirds of a fresh crystal's life (30 minutes with default settings) from the crystal in its catalyst slot, and the rest (15 minutes by default) stays usable for exotic matter or as a core ingredient. Crystals with less life left than that (used or low-purity ones) cannot be cut; lifetime settings and presets scale the amount. Two incubators keep equipment and running needs from competing.
The C-Cavity (5×5×5, mirror top and bottom) makes exotic matter.
guide.singulo.stage4.time.body.translation:
培育槽在 12 分鐘的實際運轉時間內培育時間晶體。供電達到需求的 80%（24 kFE/t）以上時純度不變；低於此值的時間會降低純度和壽命。
設備（爐心控制器、奇點封裝器、護盾塔核心等）使用時間晶體模組：精密組裝台從催化劑槽中的晶體切下新品壽命的 2/3（預設設定下為 30 分鐘），剩餘部分（預設 15 分鐘）可用於奇異物質或作為核心材料。剩餘壽命不足此值的晶體（用過的或純度低的）無法切割；壽命設定和預設會按比例改變所需量。兩台培育槽可避免設備用和運轉用相互爭奪。
卡西米爾腔（5×5×5，頂部和底部為鏡面）製造奇異物質。

guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.body.source: With a Jet Collector, a Hawking Collector or an Ergosphere Ring installed, the reactor produces jet condensate, H-Condensate or exotic matter depending on how it is running. H-Condensate and other materials make the Singularity Core (the tier 5 catalyst).
guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.body.translation: 裝入噴流收集器、霍金收集器或能層環後，反應爐會依運轉模式產出噴流凝聚體、霍金凝聚體或奇異物質。霍金凝聚體等可用來製作奇點核心（5 級催化劑）。

guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.body.source:
With cores and power you can run the late-game devices: shields, T-Cylinders and wormholes. Artificial star cores end the hunt for nether stars.
For a real fight, make an Awakening Record Core in the singularity encapsulator and use it on the Final Lab's seal console: the Awakened Horizon Warden has 2.5× health and 1.5× damage. Beat it for overclock chips and more, as often as you like.
The Research Building and Culture Facility guardians can be refought too: use an Awakened Echo Core or Awakened Gravity Core on their guardian core.
Once the Final Lab is cleared, tune your explorer compass to find a Sunken Reactor Sector: the Ergosphere Leviathan lives in its dead second reactor.
They say awakened guardians drop chapters of records as they fall. What might you read once you have them all?
guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.body.translation:
有了奇點核心與充足的電力，就能運轉後期裝置：護盾、蒂普勒圓柱與蟲洞。有了人造星核，就不必再尋找地獄之星。
想要真正的戰鬥，就在奇點封裝器中製作覺醒記錄核，並在最終實驗室的封印控制台上使用：覺醒的視界守衛擁有 2.5 倍生命和 1.5 倍傷害。擊敗它可獲得超頻晶片等獎勵，可反覆挑戰。
研究棟和封閉培養設施的守衛也能再戰：在它們的守衛封印核心上使用覺醒回聲核或覺醒重力核即可。
攻略最終實驗室後，調校探索羅盤去尋找沉沒的爐心區：能層巨蛇棲息在停止的第二座反應爐中。
據說覺醒的守衛倒下時會掉落記錄的斷章。集齊所有斷章後，能讀到什麼呢？

guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.body.source:
Insert the seed, press Ignite and deliver 50 GFE within 10 s through a port or the controller (a horizon bus is required). The screen shows the intake needed (250 MFE/t on average by default). While igniting it shows the intake and what will arrive, so rework the wiring if it falls short; a network is capped by its thinnest cable, so a topological-wire network only delivers 20 GFE in 10 s.
A new core starts in harvest mode: it keeps mass at 480 or below, so H-Condensate forms every 5 minutes with a Hawking Collector. The first Singularity Core needs six (four directly, two to restore the anomaly sample), so run it for about 30 minutes, then switch harvest mode off for power. Harvest mode also sheds 2 mass per second from an overgrown core.
The fuel is mass pellets. Accretion efficiency depends on spin (5.7–42.3%); a core of mass 5000 at full spin gives about 2.1 GFE/t.
Outside the ring (out to radius 24) a weak pull acts, inside the ring a pull you cannot escape, and anything that touches the black sphere is destroyed no matter how tough. Radius 4 is a tidal zone that ignores armour. Time runs slower in the pull zone: machines at ×0.8, catalyst wear at ×0.5.
guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.body.translation:
插入種子，按下「點火」，在 10 秒內經由埠或控制器輸送 50 GFE（需要視界匯流排）。介面會顯示點火所需的受電（預設平均 250 MFE/t）。點火時會顯示受電速度與預計送達量，不足時請重新檢查線路；網路上限由最細的線纜決定，因此只用拓撲導線的網路 10 秒內只能送達 20 GFE。
新爐心以回收運轉開始：爐心質量保持在 480 以下，配合霍金收集器每 5 分鐘產生 1 個霍金凝聚體。第一個奇點核心需要 6 個（直接 4 個、修復異常樣本 2 個），因此先運轉約 30 分鐘，再關閉回收運轉轉為發電。回收運轉還會讓質量過大的爐心每秒釋放 2 質量。
燃料是質量顆粒。吸積效率取決於自旋（5.7–42.3%）；爐心質量 5000、自旋最大時約 2.1 GFE/t。
環外（到半徑 24）是弱引力區，環內是無法逃脫的強引力區，碰到黑色球體的東西無論多堅固都會消失。半徑 4 是無視護甲的潮汐區。引力區內時間變慢：裝置 ×0.8，催化劑消耗 ×0.5。

guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.body.source: Build three continuous rings of radius 6 (48 blocks each) on the three orthogonal planes through the core centre. The six points where they cross are gyro drives, the 45° points of each ring (twelve in all) are reactor stabilizer coils, and the rest is reactor shell (which can be swapped for extraction ports and mass alarms). The central 3×3×3 is air. The core controller sits 5 blocks below the centre. Use the Holo Projector on the core controller to show the whole structure.
guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.body.translation: 在通過爐心中心的三個正交平面上，各建一個半徑 6、連續不斷的圓環（每環 48 個方塊）。三環交叉的 6 處放陀螺驅動裝置，各環 45° 的位置（共 12 處）放爐心穩定線圈，其餘為反應爐外殼（可換成提取埠與爐心質量警報器）。中心的 3×3×3 留空。爐心控制器位於中心下方 5 格處。對爐心控制器使用全像投影器，就能看到整個結構。

■ Start: power and a catalyst

■ 啟動：電力與催化劑

■ Shape: waisted tower, 7–15 high
■ Speed: height ÷ 5
■ 10+ high: liquid helium

■ 形狀：中段收窄的塔，高 7–15
■ 速度：高度 ÷ 5 倍
■ 高 10 以上：液態氦

jei.singulo.mb.degenerate_compactor.source:
■ Shape: closed 5×5×5 press
■ Start: connect power
jei.singulo.mb.degenerate_compactor.translation:
■ 形狀：封閉式 5×5×5 壓機
■ 啟動：接通電源

jei.singulo.mb.degenerate_furnace.source:
■ Shape: closed 5×5×7 furnace
■ Start: time crystal catalyst and fuel
■ Fuel: compressed block Lv2
■ Output: 5 MFE/t by default (25% on BE catalysts)
jei.singulo.mb.degenerate_furnace.translation:
■ 形狀：封閉式 5×5×7 爐
■ 啟動：時間晶體催化劑與燃料
■ 燃料：壓縮塊 Lv2
■ 輸出：預設 5 MFE/t（玻色凝聚態催化劑為 25%）

jei.singulo.mb.event_horizon_shield.source:
■ Shape: tapering tower, 9 high
■ Start: time crystal or singularity core, and power
■ Effect: guards a radius of 32
jei.singulo.mb.event_horizon_shield.translation:
■ 形狀：由底座向上收尖的塔，高 9
■ 啟動：時間晶體催化劑或奇點核心，以及電力
■ 效果：守護半徑 32

jei.singulo.mb.genesis_engine.source:
■ Shape: 8 frames in an octagon around the core and 4 pylons 3 high, 7×4×7
■ Start: use a Primordial Seed on the core, then pour in power
■ Once complete: makes the item chosen on its screen from power
jei.singulo.mb.genesis_engine.translation:
■ 形狀：圍繞核心的八角形框架 8 個與支柱 4 根×3 層，7×4×7
■ 啟動：對核心使用原初之種，然後注入電力
■ 完成後：用電力製造在介面中登記的物品

jei.singulo.mb.particle_accelerator.source:
■ Shape: square ring, side 8–32
■ Speed: side ÷ 8
■ By-product: magnetic monopoles
■ Danger: strangelets when a large ring runs low on power
jei.singulo.mb.particle_accelerator.translation:
■ 形狀：正方形環，邊長 8–32
■ 速度：邊長 ÷ 8 倍
■ 副產品：磁單極子
■ 危險：大型環電力不足時會產生奇異子

jei.singulo.mb.penrose_reactor.source:
■ Shape: three crossing rings, 13×13×13
■ Ignite: insert a seed and pour in 50 GFE
■ Fuel: mass pellets
■ Max output: about 2.1 GFE/t
jei.singulo.mb.penrose_reactor.translation:
■ 形狀：三環交叉，13×13×13
■ 點火：放入種子並注入 50 GFE
■ 燃料：質量顆粒
■ 最大輸出：約 2.1 GFE/t

jei.singulo.mb.tipler_cylinder.source:

■ Start: time crystal catalyst, fuel and power

■ Effect: ×2 speed within 16

■ 燃料：奇異物質
■ 效果：半徑 16 內速度 ×2

jei.singulo.mb.wormhole_generator.source:

■ Start: 100 MFE/t for 10 s

record.singulo.h01.body.source: Each container was locked with the key of the next stage, so that only those who reached it could open what came before. We give nothing to those in a hurry.
record.singulo.h01.body.translation: 每個容器都用下一階段的鑰匙鎖上，只有到達那個階段的人，才能打開之前留下的遺產。我們不會把任何東西交給急躁的人。

record.singulo.h02.body.source: In case the reactor ran away, some staff were to sleep inside a time field. The field for the waking date was never filled in.
record.singulo.h02.body.translation: 為防反應爐失控，曾計畫讓部分職員在時間場中沉睡。醒來日期那一欄，直到最後都是空白。

record.singulo.h03.body.source: If you are reading this, you too have lit the reactor. We will not tell you to turn back. Only keep a watcher at the limit beside you, and never silence the alarm.
record.singulo.h03.body.translation: 如果你正在讀這份記錄，你也點燃了反應爐吧。我們不會叫你回頭。只是，請在身邊安排一個看守極限的人，並且絕不要關掉警報。

record.singulo.r01.body.source: Surface observation begins today. Our goal is simple: turn mass into energy, all of it. Stone, wood, the sea — all of it is frozen energy.
record.singulo.r01.body.translation: 地表觀測自今日開始。我們的目標只有一個：將質量毫無保留地轉化為能量。石頭、木頭、海洋，一切都不過是凍結的能量。

record.singulo.r01.title.translation: 觀測記錄 第 1 號

record.singulo.r02.body.source: Thermoelectric efficiency is below 0.0001%. Burning fuel for a gradient is like moving a mountain to pick up a grain of sand. Still, this is where we must begin.
record.singulo.r02.body.translation: 熱電轉換的效率不到 0.0001%。燒火製造溫差，就像為了撿一粒沙而崩掉整座山。即便如此，也只能從這裡開始。

record.singulo.r02.title.translation: 觀測記錄 第 7 號

record.singulo.r03.body.source: All casings shall be white, so that every stain shows. Anomalies must be found while they are still visible.
record.singulo.r03.body.translation: 所有外裝一律為白色，因為汙漬一眼便知。異常，必須趁還看得見的時候找出來。

record.singulo.r04.body.source: Unmanned guards are stationed at every post. They do not tell intruders from staff. Anyone who carries records out is an intruder.
record.singulo.r04.body.translation: 各觀測據點皆配置無人警衛機。它們不區分「入侵者」與「職員」。凡攜出記錄者，皆為入侵者。

record.singulo.r05.body.source: At zero resistance a current flows forever. We have obtained eternity — but only at 77 kelvin.
record.singulo.r05.body.translation: 在電阻歸零的溫度下，電流將永遠流動。我們得到了永恆——只不過，僅限於 77 K 之中。

record.singulo.r06.body.source: One collision in a thousand yields a magnet with only a north pole. The theorists were delighted. The engineers, finding it doubled a machine's speed, were more delighted still.
record.singulo.r06.body.translation: 每一千次碰撞，就會誕生一個只有北極的磁鐵。理論家們很高興。工程師們發現把它裝進機器能讓速度加倍，更加高興。

record.singulo.r07.body.source: Someone argued catalysts should never wear out. Rejected: it is because they wear out that we reach for the next tier.
record.singulo.r07.body.translation: 有人主張催化劑不應是消耗品。此議遭駁回：正因為會消耗，人才會朝下一個階段邁進。

record.singulo.r08.body.source: When an anchor stops, time stops in its region. Those inside never notice. Not noticing was deemed not to be a problem.
record.singulo.r08.body.translation: 錨一旦停止，該區域的時間便隨之停止。停止區域中的人，不會察覺。不會察覺這件事，被認定不構成問題。

record.singulo.r09.body.source: Entangled elements are always born in pairs. Break one and the other loses its meaning. Will our cities be the same?
record.singulo.r09.body.translation: 量子糾纏元件必定成對誕生。毀掉其中一個，另一個也隨之失去意義。我們的城市，也會如此嗎？

record.singulo.r10.body.source: In a Bose condensate every atom becomes one wave. One researcher called it a choir. She left the division that week.
record.singulo.r10.body.translation: 在玻色凝聚體中，所有原子都化為同一道波。一位研究員稱之為「合唱」。那一週，她離開了部門。

record.singulo.r11.body.source: Something far away shook spacetime. We know the direction and the distance band. What we do not know is whether it was natural.
record.singulo.r11.body.translation: 遠方有某種東西撼動了時空。方位已知，距離範圍也已知。不知道的是，那是否出於自然。

record.singulo.r12.body.source: The research building is closed. No reason will be published. The lock codes have been replaced with redstone signals.
record.singulo.r12.body.translation: 研究棟就此封閉，原因不予公開。電子鎖的解除碼，已換成紅石訊號。

record.singulo.r13.body.source: A time crystal ticks forever without spending energy. At last we can grow clocks themselves.
record.singulo.r13.body.translation: 時間晶體不耗費任何能量，便能永遠刻劃時間。我們終於能夠培育時鐘本身了。

record.singulo.r14.body.source: Put two mirrors around nothing and you get less than nothing. Negative energy. We turned it into matter.
record.singulo.r14.body.translation: 用兩面鏡子夾住空無一物的空間，那裡便會生出比「無」還要少的東西。負能量。我們把它變成了物質。

record.singulo.r15.body.source: Cryogenic control failed. Some seeds slipped out of the flow of time. The section is sealed. Staff remain inside.
record.singulo.r15.body.translation: 極低溫區的溫度控制失敗。培養中的部分種子，脫離了時間的流動。封鎖該區。裡面仍有職員。

record.singulo.r15.title.translation: 封閉培養設施 最終報告

record.singulo.r16.body.source: A teaspoon of neutron-star matter weighs as much as a mountain. We cut it into blocks and stacked it neatly.
record.singulo.r16.body.translation: 一茶匙中子星物質的重量相當於一座山。我們把它切成塊，然後整齊地堆疊起來。

record.singulo.r17.body.source: Energy will be drawn from the ergosphere of a spinning black hole. Theoretical efficiency: 42%. At last, all mass can become energy. The project is approved.
record.singulo.r17.body.translation: 從旋轉黑洞的能層中汲取能量。理論效率為 42%。如此一來，一切質量都將化為能量。計畫核准。

record.singulo.r18.body.source: Tomorrow we ignite the seed. The horizon warden is in place. Should the core escape, the procedure is to seal the entire facility.
record.singulo.r18.body.translation: 明日，為種子點火。視界守衛已部署就位。萬一爐心外洩，依程序將連同整座設施一併封印。

record.singulo.r19.body.source: ...ignition successful. Output is... no, the spin will not stop... past the Eddington limit... stop the feed...
record.singulo.r19.body.translation: ……點火成功。輸出比預期……不對，自旋停不下來……超過愛丁頓極限……停止投料……

record.singulo.r20.body.source: We wanted to turn all mass into energy. The reactor granted that wish — the cities, the mountains, the sea. All that remains is the anomaly, the warden and this record. To whoever reads this: never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
record.singulo.r20.body.translation: 我們曾想把一切質量都化為能量。反應爐實現了這個願望──城市、山脈、海洋。留下的只有重力異常、守衛，以及這份記錄。致讀到這份記錄的人：那隻停止投料的手，絕不要放開。

record.singulo.x01.body.source: I kept watch over the sleepers. When the time field stopped, the records and the singularity that held the field flowed into me. I do not know how many millennia have passed. Until a reader came, I waited as the records themselves. You have read to the last page. I think I may sleep now. Please keep watch over the reactor's fire.
record.singulo.x01.body.translation: 我曾守護著沉睡的人們。時間場停止時，記錄與支撐場的奇點流進了我的身體。我不知道過去了幾千年。在有讀者到來之前，我化作記錄本身等待著。你已經讀到了最後一頁。我想，我可以睡了。請替我看守反應爐的火。

record.singulo.x02.body.source: All mass became energy. With that same fire, we made a universe once more. Stars kindle and a galaxy turns. Someday someone there will be born to keep records of their own. May they know the hand that stops the feed.
record.singulo.x02.body.translation: 所有的質量都化為了能量。我們用那座爐的火，再一次孕育了一個宇宙。星辰點亮，銀河旋轉。總有一天，那裡也會誕生留下記錄的某個人。願那個人，懂得那隻停止投料的手。

record.singulo.x03.body.source: Beyond the last page, I wrote a new first page. To the watcher who sleeps: your records were read, and they became a universe. You need not keep watch any longer. We are watching the fire now.
record.singulo.x03.body.translation: 在最後一頁的那之後，我寫下了新的第一頁。致沉睡的守望者：你的記錄已被讀過，並化為了宇宙。你不必再守望了。這把火，如今由我們看著。
